# Lane 2.26 — Page cache labels

## Built (commit 04151928)

1. `packages/providers/src/page-cache/`: `PageCache.clear(labels)`; labels `league:{id}`, `league:{id}:season:{id}:standings|results|stats`, `league:{id}:game:{id}` (`labelsForGameResult`); local stand-in that records what it cleared; "off"; Cloudflare purge by tag (30 tags a call, 4 s wait, fixed error codes). Exported through `packages/providers/index.ts`.
2. Core (standings module): `clearPagesOnGameFinalized` / `clearPagesOnGameReopened`, in `standingsHandlers` and so in core's `eventHandlers`: one `cache.clear` job `{ seasonId, gameId }` in the result's transaction (T-130), none when refused, no dedupe key.
3. Worker: `jobs/cache-clear-job.ts`, always offered in `jobHandlers` (required `pageCache` dep); `wire-worker.ts` gives the stand-in locally and in tests, "off" in staging and production.
4. Web: `server/cache-headers.ts` (`sharedFor` ≤ 2 s with `Cache-Tag`, `notKept` = `private, no-store`); the snapshot's shared answer is labeled with its league and game. Pages unchanged: all `private, no-store`.
5. Done tests: `apps/worker/src/jobs/cache-clear-job.test.ts` (finalizing clears exactly its season's labels and its game's; another season's and league's stay), `packages/core/src/modules/standings/clear-page-cache.test.ts`; `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` now checks EVERY page case (every kind of person) is `private` + `no-store` with no cache label (`keptByOthers`), and `checkSnapshotCache` (visitor: public 2 s, labeled; owner and stranger: private).

## Decisions

- T-309 (pending, `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-309.md`, Agreed (delegated)) and record 106: label format, the job, "off" outside local work, only the snapshot shared. The pinned T4 row count was not touched (T-309 is under T5).
- Spec corrected: T5 §4 (T-309 paragraph), T7 §2 `cache.clear` row.
- Choice on caching: pages stay never-cacheable (the account button, "signed in as" and a staff pencil are drawn in the page), at the cost of speed, until step 2.127 moves personal parts after the page.

## Not verified

- The Cloudflare adapter: written from the published API, tested only against made-up answers; no network call, no account, no token. Which plan purges by tag and the per-call limit are to be checked when the zone is set up.

## Checks run

`npm run check` passed; `npm run typecheck` passed; prettier on all changed files passed; vitest: packages/core, packages/providers, apps/worker, apps/web/src/server, packages/database/src/stores all passed; `node --test tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` passed; `npm run test:web` passed (263 checks, before the snapshot check was counted; rerun not needed as it passed with it).
